name: synology-mcp
description: Optional add-on: connects Claude Code to a self-hosted Synology NAS MCP server (atom2ueki/mcp-server-synology) over SSE, via mcp-proxy. The server URL is supplied per-consumer via userConfig at enable time and never committed to this repo.

synology_mcp_url.title: Synology MCP server SSE URL
synology_mcp_url.description: Full SSE endpoint of your own self-hosted Synology MCP server, e.g. https://your-host/sse — mcp-proxy's default transport and path (see plugins/synology-mcp/README.md for how to run one). Stored in secure local storage, never in this repo.
